## PLASTIC SURGERY
Antimicrobial prophylaxis is not recommended for most clean procedures in
patients without additional postoperative infection risk factors.
Risk factors that increase the risk of postoperative infectious complications
for plastic surgery procedures include implants, skin irradiation before the
procedure, and procedures below the waist.
Antimicrobial prophylaxis is recommended for clean-contaminated procedures,
breast cancer procedures, and clean procedures with risk factors. A single
preoperative dose is recommended.
## If no antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended, select below:
*No antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended
## Clean with risk factors or clean-contaminated:
## Preferred Prophylaxis:
[Cefazolin 2 gm IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision](orzid2-gmenu-surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)
($) [R]
## Alternative for beta-lactam allergy:
Clindamycin 900 mg IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision
($$) [H,O]
[Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV beginning 120 minutes before incision ($) [R]](orzid2-gmenu-surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)
